commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-final.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="1a1b3de8dada926a00f37be158ef99cd1393b860"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
git diff --check 472face97b21aa4e3f838a424d8245b3dee45b17 HEAD
echo "SPRINT_DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
test -f docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-bloomml-ipo-v2-activation-transaction.md
test -f src/climate/runtime/profile/IpoProfileActivationTransaction.h
grep -q 'ClosedIpoActivationGate ipo_activation_gate' src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp
grep -q 'docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-bloomml-ipo-v2-activation-transaction.md' docs/NEXT_CHAT.md
echo "CHECKPOINT_AND_CLOSED_GATE|PASS"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "WORKTREE|CLEAN"
git log -1 --format='FINAL_SHA|%H'
